instruction: Clone sda to sdb with dcfldd showing hash every 512 blocks
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hashwindow=512 hash=md5 statusinterval=512

instruction: Clone and log MD5 hash to a separate file
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img hash=md5 hashlog=disk.md5

instruction: Clone with SHA256 hash and verify log
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img hash=sha256 hashlog=disk.sha256 verifylog=disk.sha256

instruction: Split output into 2GiB chunks with dcfldd
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img split=2G

instruction: Clone using multiple output files and verify each
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=part1.img of=part2.img hashwindow=1024 hash=sha512 vf=part1.img

instruction: Forensic clone with SHA384, 1MiB hash window, 10MiB status interval
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=sha384 hashwindow=1M statusinterval=10M

instruction: Log all hash types simultaneously with dcfldd
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img hash=md5 hashlog=disk.md5 hash=sha1 hashlog=disk.sha1 hash=sha256 hashlog=disk.sha256 hash=sha384 hashlog=disk.sha384 hash=sha512 hashlog=disk.sha512

instruction: View dcfldd version and compile options
output: dcfldd --version

instruction: Set sector size to 4096 for advanced format drives
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb ssz=4096 hash=md5

instruction: Resume split operation without overwriting existing chunks
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img split=2G

instruction: dc3dd clone with error log and MD5 hash
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=md5 hlog=clone.md5 errorlog=errors.log

instruction: dc3dd split output into 1GiB files with SHA256
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img ofsz=1G hash=sha256 hlog=disk.sha256

instruction: dc3dd clone 500GiB drive with SHA512 and progress every 5 seconds
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=sha512 hlog=disk.sha512 pfn=5

instruction: dc3dd verbose clone with all available hash algorithms logged
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=md5 hash=sha256 hash=sha512 hlog=disk.hashes errorlog=dc3dd.err

instruction: dc3dd restore from split image files
output: dc3dd if=disk.img of=/dev/sdb

instruction: dc3dd wipe a drive with zero pattern
output: dc3dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdb

instruction: dc3dd clone with output file split and no hash
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img ofsz=500M log=clone.log

instruction: dc3dd print version
output: dc3dd --version

instruction: dcfldd clone with SHA512 and size-based split at 4GiB
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=disk.img hash=sha512 split=4G ssz=512

instruction: dc3dd verbose mode with full logging
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb verbose=on log=full.log

instruction: dcfldd forensic copy with zero-block pattern fill for unreadable sectors
output: dcfldd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=sha256 hashlog=disk.sha256 conv=noerror,notrunc

instruction: dc3dd clone with pattern verification after copy
output: dc3dd if=/dev/sda of=/dev/sdb hash=sha256 hlog=verify.sha256
